service.en: Replace a lost driving learning permit
service.ar: بدل فاقد لتصريح التدريب على القيادة
service.ur: گم شدہ ڈرائیونگ لرننگ پرمٹ کی تبدیلی
service.ml: നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട ഡ്രൈവിംഗ് ലേണിംഗ് പെർമിറ്റ് മാറ്റി വാങ്ങൽ

about: Get a replacement for a lost Learning to Drive permit.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: 100 AED for motorcycle and light vehicle categories
200 AED for bus, heavy vehicle and machinery categories
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
an Integrated Transport Center service centre
